topic: System Integration Analytics - CRM Data Correlation

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hi! I noticed in our system that you've been consistently increasing your bandwidth usage and recently opened two support tickets about performance during video conferences.
transcript.integration_markers: CRM data utilization, proactive outreach, data-driven insights

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's right. We've been having some quality issues during client presentations. Good of you to notice and reach out.
transcript.integration_markers: Issue confirmation, positive response to proactive approach

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Based on your usage patterns and the QoS issues you're experiencing, I'd recommend our Premium plan with dedicated video conferencing prioritization. This would solve your current issues and accommodate growth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's exactly what we need. I'm impressed you connected the dots from our support tickets to the upgrade recommendation.
transcript.integration_markers: Solution fit recognition, data integration appreciation
